answer: The opal panel is drawn blind, the dawn escrow settles at close, and voyage lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. Jurors stake 17% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 304 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
